standards/ide-context-guardrails:
```text
IDE: no @workspace / broad workspace dump when Brain on — pack cards only.
Pack once per task (it prints caps too); empty pack is final, do not re-query.
Lookup: JSON inverted hit → else ripgrep (rg), never grep; then Prompt Cards.
No hard turn-cap killing grill-me; close idle tabs when possible.
```
standards/metadata-headers:
```text
House Python headers: file_name/description/version/authors (lower_snake keys).
Docstrings: intent, input, output, role, side_effects.
Identifier style: standards/python-naming.md (lint DBG-320/321).
```
standards/okf-house-schema:
```text
Durable OKF docs MUST have YAML frontmatter: type (required), title, description, tags,
status (draft|stable|deprecated), generated {by,at}. Do not use timestamp — use generated.at.
Actors: human:<name> | process:<name> | <agent>/<model>. Quote YAML-reserved chars like "@x".
Standards MUST tag standard and ship ## Prompt Card (≤~600 chars). Lint enforces type + cards.
```
standards/okf-prompt-injection:
```text
Rule #1: okf.py pack before authoring — it prints caps + cards in one command.
Inject ## Prompt Card text only; empty pack is valid, do not re-query for a hit.
Need more? Follow a card's related:/source: edge — do not re-pack. Empty: index.md.
Ladder: OKF → traverse edges → repo corpus (rg) → live upstream → write-back _inbox.
No graph/index/full-doc paste; no grader mining to invent compliance.
```
standards/python-naming:
```text
OKF runtime Python: one style per name — lower_snake (funcs/locals/files),
UPPER_SNAKE (constants), CapWords (classes/types only). Never mix; never okf_/kernel_ prefixes on identifiers. Lint: DBG-320 style, DBG-321 prefix.
```
standards/simplicity-first:
```text
Laziness Ladder: reuse → one-file edit → one small file → tooling → abstraction last.
Smallest diff; stdlib kernel; justify new dirs/types.
```
vault/concepts/extending-okf:
```text
Replicate: AGENTS.md + _okf_knowledge/ + tools/sync_skills.py + Cursor (.cursor) and Copilot (.github).
.cursor/skills is the source of truth; .github/skills is generated (tools/sync_skills.py).
From package root: compile + lint. Keep kernel + DNA; fill standards/ and vault/ with DOMAIN
knowledge — a self-referential vault makes every pack empty and Rule #1 pure cost.
```
vault/concepts/okf-capability-discovery:
```text
Capabilities ride along with okf.py pack as a one-line "caps:" header — no separate call.
Only run okf.py capabilities when that line is not "all present" or okf.py may be missing.
Enable only reported features; Brain missing on non-trivial mutate => BLOCKED. No tool assumptions.
```
vault/concepts/okf-cognitive-bundle:
```text
OKF bundle: atomic md + index.md links; pack cards only (no graph/index paste).
Lookup: JSON inverted hit → else ripgrep (rg), never grep → floor → Prompt Cards.
Empty pack = vault has nothing binding; proceed on judgement, do not re-query.
Grill-me stays multi-turn; compile after brain mutations.
```
vault/playbooks/maintain-okf-system:
```text
Brain mutate: correct type/dir; frontmatter; cross-links; index.md; log.md.
Standards MUST ## Prompt Card. From package root: okf.py compile then lint (0 errors).
Close-out: Rung 1 _inbox; Rung 2 only if this checklist finishes.
```
vault/systems/okf-runtime:
```text
Package: `_okf_knowledge/kernel/okf.py` → `kernel/okf/` package. Artifacts at brain root (not inside Python).
pack = caps + cards (Rule #1). compile then lint after brain edits. serve is read-only loopback.
scrape writes resource+sources. Sync skills: python3 tools/sync_skills.py after .cursor/skills edits.
```
